store_info.description_short: Privacy-first, self-hosted web analytics: track visitor traffic, events and conversions without cookies or third-party data sharing.
description_long: Umami is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics. It tracks page views, events, traffic sources and conversions without cookies, without selling visitor data, and without needing a cookie-consent banner in most jurisdictions.

Everything stays on your own shard: Umami stores its data in a PostgreSQL database running alongside it, and nothing is sent to a third party except optional anonymous telemetry, which is disabled by default on Freeshard.
hint: The dashboard is paired-devices-only; Umami's own login screen is still used to get in. The default account is username 'admin', password 'umami' — log in and change the password immediately. The tracking script (/script.js) and data-collection endpoint (/api/send) are public so visitors to the websites you track can reach them without being paired to your shard.

An MCP server is enabled at /mcp so AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) can query your analytics. It's public but requires a Umami API key: in the dashboard, go to Settings → API keys → Create key, then configure your MCP client with that key as a Bearer token against https://umami.<your-shard-domain>/mcp. Keep the key secret — it's the only thing gating that endpoint.
